buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer.

6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Participating traders/agents/dealers/reseller/distributors have to attach valid authorized dealership certi ficate /letter from the OEM. 2) Preferred makes are HP, ACER, LENOVO, ASUS AND DELL. Bidders quoting for other makes shall submit the following without which the offer is liable to be rejected. a) Details of functional and fully operational authorised service centre in Chennai. The following details are to be submitted with the offer (i) The complete address, contact number & email-ID of the service centre (ii) GST certificate of the service centre (iii) Listing of the service centre in the OEM website Railways reserve the right to physically verify the existence and functionality of the Service Centre and/or verify the same through the OEM or the OEM’s official website at the stage of offer evaluation. If the Servic e Centre is found to be non-existent, non-functional, or otherwise unsatisfactory, the offer shall be liable to be rejected b) Certificate issued by any central/state/PSU organization regarding the successful working of the comput er of the offered make. The period covered in the certificate shall not be less than one year. The format is given in the annexure. c) While evaluating the offers, the performance of the computers of the offered make, supplied by the bidd er/OEM under the contract submitted in support of the Past Performance criterion shall be verified with the concerned Buyer/Consignee mentioned in the said contract. The verification may include, inter alia, the qu ality and performance of the supplied computers, timely delivery, installation and commissioning, warrant y/after-sales service, response to complaints, and overall satisfactory performance. If the performance is f ound to be unsatisfactory or the information furnished by the bidder is found to be incorrect, the offer is lia ble to be rejected. Railway reserves the right to accept/reject the offer based on past performance of the brand offered to ensure quality/ timely honouring of warranty obligations of the offered product. 3) COMPLIANCE/ OFFERED VALUE for Specifications mentioned in the Additional specification parameters must be uploaded along with offer for technical evaluation purpose, failing which offer is liable to be reject ed. 4) Past Performance: The Bidder should have supplied computer of the same make for 50% of bid quantity (10 numbers), in at least one of the last three Financial years (i.e. in 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) or durin g the current financial year before the bid opening date to any Central/ State Govt organization / PSU. Copi es of relevant contracts & CRAC (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. 5) Please mention correct HSN code for the offered product. . 7.
